sections.Profile:
"Canasta" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in June 1950. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and 13 kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Card games, Original Theme
